{{Quote|I'm Rogun's best&mdash;you think a few shots to the head can stop me?|Dust|<ref name="TOR" />}}
"'''Dust'''" was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] living during the [[Galactic War]] and [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher's]] best [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. He had a reputation for dying multiple times, but always coming back. Around [[3641 BBY]] Rogun send Dust to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], on assignment to kill [[Ivory]] and the smuggler later known as [[Voidhound]]. He first attempted to kill the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in the [[High Security Section]] with the help of [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Legat]], but got shot in the head instead.<ref name="TOR" /> Later, he attacked Voidhound and Ivory in [[the Tomb]], when the two cooperated and shot him down again. He managed to get up and attack them again before being killed once more. This time, the two criminals left the scene before Dust could arise and hunt them again.

==Behind the scenes==
If [[Languss Tuno]] is the player's companion, he will identify Dust. Since Dust is killed by the player three times and revives on screen at least once, his death described here may not be the ultimate one.<ref name="TOR" />
